title: Product names and SDK or API names with a source: Internet & SaaS, Private Access, Zscaler App, Zero Trust Browser, ZBI, ZGuard, ecgroup, deep trace, ZTC

prose.text: Names that a captured source shows directly. Others are listed in [[shared.terminology]] with their status.

service-names.statement: Current help pages name ZIA Internet & SaaS and ZPA Private Access, for example "Public Service Edges for Internet & SaaS (ZIA)" and "Private Access (ZPA)".

quotes: A subcloud is a subset of Public Service Edges for Internet & SaaS (ZIA)
Private Access (ZPA) was built from the ground up to provide secure remote access.

zscaler-app.statement: The NSS web log lists the Client Connector forwarding method value as "Zscaler Client Connector (Zscaler App)", with Zscaler App in parentheses.

zero-trust-browser.statement: Zero Trust Browser was formerly Zscaler Isolation; the NSS web log's field descriptions call it "Zero Trust Browser (formerly Isolation)".

quotes: Zero Trust Browser (formerly Zscaler Isolation) is a secure platform
Applicable to the web traffic processed via Zero Trust Browser (formerly Isolation).

zscaler-app-alias.statement: Zscaler App is therefore a name for Zscaler Client Connector in Zscaler's own log vocabulary.
zscaler-app-alias.conditions: Reads the parenthetical as an alternate name; unlike the Zero Trust Browser rows, the log format does not say formerly.

zguard-alias.statement: In the Python SDK, `client.zguard` is a deprecated alias for the `aiguard` property.

zbi-is-business-insights.statement: In the Python SDK, the `zbi` service client is Zscaler Business Insights, not browser isolation.

ecgroup.statement: In the Cloud & Branch Connector API, /ecgroup lists Cloud & Branch Connector groups, under the tag Cloud & Branch Connector Groups.

zdx-deep-trace.statement: The ZDX API calls its on-demand per-device trace a deep trace: POST /v1/devices/{id}/deeptraces starts one on a device, limited to one active session per device and 15 active sessions across all devices, counting sessions started from the UI.

expect.description: Start deep trace on a device. Limited to 1 active session on a device at any time. Overall 15 active sessions at any point of time across all devices - includes sessions initiated from UI.

ztc-expansion.statement: The Terraform provider ZTC is the provider for Zscaler Zero Trust Cloud resources.

quotes: The ZTC provider is a Terraform plugin that allows for the full lifecycle management of Zscaler Zero Trust Cloud resources.
